data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Gross adverse movement on the 2017 underwriting year compared to the one-year-later estimate (gross ultimate increased from 126.128m to 133.952m), partially offset by reinsurance such that net development was favourable.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 Syndicate 1206 carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 321.993m. During 2019 prior-year gross claims strengthened by GBP 7.824m (2.43% of opening gross reserves) on the remaining 2017 year of account (gross ultimate moved from GBP 126.128m at one year later to GBP 133.952m at current estimate). The report attributes the movement to favourable developments in Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting adverse development in other classes; after reinsurance the syndicate reported a net prior-year improvement of GBP 1.0m.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
Actual vs expected claims development was favourable in the period driven by the Professional Indemnity and Property Binders classes.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims taken from balance sheet (31 Dec 2018: GBP 321,993k). The syndicate had completed an external RITC on 2016 & prior at 31 Dec 2018 and the technical notes present an adjusted opening figure (70,833k) after removing the brought-forward 2016&Prior RITC; the balance-sheet closing figure (321,993k) is used here per instruction. Prior-year development (gross) computed from the 2017 underwriting year gross claims development table (gross ultimate moved from 126,128k one-year-later to 133,952k current estimate = +7,824k). The report states a net prior-year improvement of GBP 1.0m (net of reinsurance) - net vs gross differences arise from reinsurance recoverables. The claims triangle is limited to the 2017 year (the syndicate was in run-off with only 2017 remaining after 2016&Prior RITC), so aggregate PYD is effectively the 2017 movement. Where class-level gross movements were not provided, LOB directions are inferred from narrative only.
